snippet.title: Survival Crisis Z - (No Commentary)
snippet.description:
One of the first games by James Silva, who is nowadays better known for his Salt and Sanctuary series. Survival Crisis Z or SCZ is a 2004 indie sandbox horror game where at first glance everything seems to indicate that this is a regular ol' zombie apocalypse but as time goes on both the body horror and supernatural elements become more prevalent.

The game was first for sale back in 2004 before becoming free to download in 2007. According to the developer, this was one of his more successful early projects.

As for the game's legacy, SCZ retained a small cult following over the years and would serve as an inspiration for the game Project Zomboid.

Game link:
https://archive.org/details/scz_20220220
(The game will most likely require you to sort some things out before it will run, please follow the link below for how to get the game to launch if it errors out:
https://www.pcgamingwiki.com/wiki/Survival_Crisis_Z
If the game loads but runs poorly or slowly then you will need to download DxWnd and choose to run the game in DirectX 8 so that the performance doesn't tank. Link to that program below:
https://dxwnd.org/)
